items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; keep private. Official API access is evidenced, but current public terms do not establish rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize returned data. Technical, security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, and owner gates also remain blocked. Human counsel is required for disputed commercial/public-display interpretation or affiliate/advertising use. Ordinary reversible growth is conditionally clear when it adds no new data use and preserves disclosures, consent, rights, claims, and existing instrumentation.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed. No task is closeable because required deliverables remain incomplete. Next evidence actions are owner authorization for a written Woot permission request; a read-only data-flow and retention table; deployed GA4 consent and property-settings capture; and an operator/vendor/log inventory covering incident and data-request procedures.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked; missing written rights for storage, derivatives, public display, caching, alerts, field use, attribution, freshness, correction, and takedown. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed; missing data inventory, retention, deletion/correction workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed; missing deployed consent and withdrawal proof, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdiction-specific review. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, and incident/request procedures. Smallest next actions are the corresponding read-only evidence captures; obtain human counsel before any disputed commercial use or public launch.

Compliance and data-quality disposition: do not block ordinary growth solely for incomplete telemetry. Compliance records 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown; site-specific failures or unknowns require review before monetization or materially new processing. Analytics permissions/errors and stale windows limit measurement, while the aggregate $4.92 affiliate commission is not site-attributable and cannot support ROI or causal claims. No legal go-live approval is supported for the gated product.
